description: Rank top Greek public-procurement entities. role=buyer (default) or supplier; by=spend (default — COMMITTED procurement value in EUR, counted ONCE per procurement: deduplicated across sources and lifecycle stages, tenders excluded), single_bidder (count of ≤1-bid awards/contracts) or direct_award (count of απευθείας ανάθεση). Answers 'top 10 suppliers by public revenue', 'which buyers award most without competition'. Returns afm, name, metric, total. Precomputed and refreshed every 6 hours, so it is instant and always the top 15.

limit.description: max 15, default 15 — the published ranking holds the top 15

name: rank_entities

metric.description: EUR when by=spend, otherwise a count of acts

total.description: total acts for this entity in the ranked set

title: Rank Buyers or Suppliers
